title: Onyx schedule and union scale
summary: Six nights a week; scale about $125 in the top union bracket.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Well, how many nights would the Kirby band play at the Onyx? How many nights a week? Was it six nights a week or seven? You had night off, I guess. What was the night off?

Let's see... It was six nights. Six nights a week. Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday... I can't remember whether it was Sunday or Monday. I don't remember now. One of them days we was off. The place closed that particular... Either Sunday or Monday
Were the wages good? Did you play for scale? Did the Kirby band play for scale?
Well, we played for scale then...
I think the scale was about $125.
Yes. They had different classes... The union had different classes. Class C, Class B, Class A. We was in the top bracket.
Oh, that's pretty good for the Depression Era.
